product_overview: A Laravel-based multi-branch POS and accounting backend for retail sales, inventory control, stock receipts, and double-entry bookkeeping. The system supports role-based access across master, superadmin, branch admin, and cashier users with branch-scoped data isolation.
core_goals: Provide secure Sanctum-based authentication for seeded local users and production users.
Enforce role-based authorization for journals, branches, products, and reporting endpoints.
Maintain accurate inventory and financial consistency through balanced double-entry postings.
Support multi-branch data isolation so each branch only sees its allowed operational scope.
Enable POS checkout and goods receipt workflows that update stock and journals atomically.
Expose consolidated reports and master data endpoints for authorized users only.

features.name: Sanctum login
features.description: Allows users to authenticate with email and password, receive a bearer token, view their profile, and revoke the active token on logout.
user_flows: POST /api/login with valid email and password -> Receive 200 with Sanctum token and user object -> GET /api/user with Bearer token -> Receive 200 with authenticated user profile including role and branch -> POST /api/logout with Bearer token -> Receive 200 and token revoked
POST /api/login with wrong password -> Receive 401 Invalid credentials -> GET /api/user without token -> Receive 401 Missing token

features.name: Journals RBAC
features.description: Controls access to manual journal creation and listing so only master users can manage accounting journals through the API.
user_flows: POST /api/login with master credentials -> Receive 200 with token -> POST /api/journals with balanced debit and credit lines -> Receive 201 Journal created -> GET /api/journals with Bearer token -> Receive 200 with journal list

POST /api/login with cashier or branch admin credentials -> Receive 200 with token -> POST /api/journals with any payload -> Receive 403 Forbidden -> GET /api/journals with same token -> Receive 403 Forbidden
POST /api/journals without bearer token -> Receive 401 Unauthenticated

features.name: Consolidated financial reports
features.description: Provides balance sheet, income statement, and sales reports with master-only or branch-scoped access depending on the endpoint and caller role.
user_flows: POST /api/login with master credentials -> Receive 200 with token -> GET /api/reports/balance-sheet with Accept: application/json -> Receive 200 with consolidated balance sheet where difference equals 0.00 -> GET /api/reports/income-statement -> Receive 200 with consolidated income statement
POST /api/login with branch admin credentials -> Receive 200 with token -> GET /api/reports/sales -> Receive 200 with sales report scoped to own branch_id

POST /api/login with cashier credentials -> Receive 200 with token -> GET /api/reports/balance-sheet -> Receive 200 only if the endpoint allows the current middleware scope, otherwise the intended requirement is 403 or restricted branch-scoped access for non-master callers

features.name: Master data access
features.description: Manages branches, categories, and products with strict authorization so only approved roles can create or administer master data.
user_flows: POST /api/login with superadmin or master credentials -> Receive 200 with token -> GET /api/branches -> Receive 200 with branch collection -> POST /api/branches with branch data -> Receive 200 or 201 for allowed role
POST /api/login with cashier credentials -> Receive 200 with token -> GET /api/branches -> Receive 403 Only superadmin -> POST /api/branches -> Receive 403 Only superadmin

POST /api/login with authenticated user -> Receive 200 with token -> GET /api/categories -> Receive 200 with global category list -> POST /api/categories with name -> Receive 403 for cashier and branch admin, 201 only for allowed role

POST /api/login with cashier credentials -> Receive 200 with token -> POST /api/products with category_id, name, purchase_price, and selling_price -> Receive 403 Cashier forbidden -> POST /api/products with allowed role -> Receive 201 Created

features.name: Branch isolation Pakan versus Pupuk
features.description: Restricts product and barcode visibility so each branch only sees its own branch data and does not leak the other division’s stock or names.
user_flows: POST /api/login with Pakan branch admin credentials -> Receive 200 with token -> GET /api/products -> Receive 200 with products for caller branch only -> GET /api/products/barcode/{barcode} for an item in the same branch -> Receive 200 Product

POST /api/login with Pakan branch admin credentials -> Receive 200 with token -> GET /api/products?branch_id=other-division-id -> Receive 200 without leaking the other division in data or other_branch_stock -> GET /api/products/barcode/{barcode} for an item in the other division -> Receive 404 Not in caller branch

POST /api/login with Pupuk branch admin credentials -> Receive 200 with token -> GET /api/products -> Receive 200 with products for Pupuk branch only -> GET /api/products/barcode/{barcode} for a Pakan item -> Receive 404 Not in caller branch

features.name: Checkout stock and goods receipt
features.description: Processes POS sales and receiving workflows, ensuring stock updates and accounting postings happen atomically with server-side validation.
user_flows: POST /api/login with master credentials -> Receive 200 with token -> POST /api/checkout with an in-stock item and valid discount -> Receive 200 Sale and balanced journal -> Verify stock decreases and journal balances
POST /api/login with master credentials -> Receive 200 with token -> POST /api/checkout with quantity above available stock -> Receive 422 Stock or discount rejected -> Verify stock remains unchanged

POST /api/login with master credentials -> Receive 200 with token -> POST /api/goods-receipts with receipt lines -> Receive 201 Receipt posted -> Verify stock increases and a balanced inventory journal is created

POST /api/login with master credentials -> Receive 200 with token -> POST /api/goods-receipts or /api/checkout with invalid discount above subtotal or negative discount -> Receive 422 Stock or discount rejected

features.name: Sanctum login
features.description: Local seeder login returns a Sanctum bearer token. Each role must login separately and keep its own token. Password for every local seeder account is password. Master email master@majubersama.test. Pakan branch admin asep@mb.pkn on branch CBG-PKN TOKO PAKAN, and gudang@pakan.178 on GUDANG-PAKAN. Pupuk branch admin gudang@pupuk.178 on GUDANG-PUPUK and admin@mb.abi on CBG-ABI. Cashiers kasir@pakan.mb and pipin@kasir.pupuk. Roles master and superadmin are full access. branch_admin is limited to its own branch_id. cashier is least privilege.

endpoints.description: Login with email and password. Wrong password returns 401. Success returns 200 and token.
Profile of the bearer token owner, including role and branch.

features.name: Journals RBAC
features.description: POST /api/journals is master only (TC007). No token returns 401. Cashier and branch admin return 403. Master accepts a balanced two-decimal journal with 201 and rejects an unbalanced journal with 422 and no header. A balanced body uses two lines whose debit total equals credit total, for example cash account code 1110 debit 25.00 and revenue 4110 credit 25.00. Master can also GET /api/journals. Branch admin and cashier must receive 403 on both GET and POST.

endpoints.description: Create a manual journal. Master 201 when balanced, 422 when unbalanced. Cashier and branch_admin 403. Guest 401.

response_schema.403: Forbidden for cashier and branch admin

endpoints.description: List journals. Master 200. Cashier and branch admin 403.

features.name: Consolidated financial reports
features.description: Master can read the consolidated balance sheet and income statement. Balance sheet difference must be 0.00 at two decimal places. Non-master callers must not receive another division's figures. Send Accept application/json.

endpoints.description: Consolidated balance sheet for master. difference must be 0.
Income statement. Master may omit branch_id for consolidation.
Sales report. Non-master is limited to own branch_id.

features.name: Master data access
features.description: Branches are superadmin only. Categories are global to read, but create update and delete are master only and must return 403 for cashier and branch admin. Product create is master data and must return 403 for a cashier.

endpoints.description: List every branch. Master 200. Cashier and branch admin 403.
Create a branch. Cashier must receive 403.
List global categories. Authenticated users may read names. This is not branch-private data.
Create a category. Cashier and branch admin must receive 403.
Create a product. Cashier must receive 403. Do not treat a 201 as success for a cashier.

response_schema.201: Created only for an allowed role

features.name: Branch isolation Pakan versus Pupuk
features.description: Two divisions exist. Pupuk office OFFICE-PUPUK with children GUDANG-PUPUK, CBG-ABI, CBG-MAMA, CBG-AROFAH, CBG-TULUSAYU, CBG-LUBUKHARJO. Pakan office OFFICE-PAKAN with children GUDANG-PAKAN and CBG-PKN TOKO PAKAN. A Pakan branch admin may see only products, stock, and transactions of their own branch_id. They must not see Pupuk branch names, product rows, or stock. The same rule applies in reverse for a Pupuk admin against Pakan. GET /api/products supports search and branch_id. The JSON field other_branch_stock must not contain Pupuk branch names or stock when the caller is a Pakan admin, and must not contain Pakan data when the caller is a Pupuk admin. HasBranchScope filters the caller's exact branch_id only, not the whole office tree.

endpoints.description: List products for the token's branch. Must not leak the other division in data or other_branch_stock, even if branch_id of the other division is passed.
Barcode lookup stays inside the caller branch.

features.name: Checkout stock and goods receipt
features.description: Covered by tests/Feature/Api. Checkout uses the server selling price, decreases stock, and posts a balanced journal. Quantity above stock returns 422 and rolls back. A purchase order does not change stock. A goods receipt increases stock and posts a balanced inventory journal. Single-level discount is bounded. These flows are exercised as master unless a role case says otherwise.

endpoints.description: POS sale. Over-stock returns 422. Discount above subtotal or negative discount returns 422.
Receipt posts stock and a balanced journal. The purchase order alone does not move stock.

known_limitations.issue: Product index attaches other_branch_stock by SKU using Product::withoutGlobalScopes, so a branch admin can see stock and branch names outside their branch when SKUs match.
known_limitations.impact: Admin Pakan may see Pupuk stock, and the reverse, inside other_branch_stock.

known_limitations.issue: HasBranchScope filters only the authenticated user's exact branch_id, not the parent office tree.
known_limitations.impact: Sibling branches in the same division are isolated from each other, and a query for another branch_id must still not return that branch's rows.

known_limitations.issue: POST /api/products is authorized for any authenticated user in StoreProductRequest, so a cashier may not receive 403.
known_limitations.impact: Cashier may create master product data.

known_limitations.issue: GET /api/reports/balance-sheet and income-statement are outside the view-accounting middleware, so a cashier token may read a branch-scoped statement.
known_limitations.impact: Report access is broader than journal access.

known_limitations.issue: Branch admin can still post a manual journal through the web route POST /backoffice/finance/journals. There is no master-only update, delete, or void route for journals.
known_limitations.impact: API TC007 can pass while web RBAC for journals remains open. Record this as a gap, not as finished RBAC.

known_limitations.issue: PHPUnit tests in tests/Feature/Api use an in-memory Sanctum user and one synthetic branch. They do not prove Pakan versus Pupuk isolation on the running server.
known_limitations.impact: Live tokens are required for the division audit.
